description: ADO-EDIT with an edit pending, on eleven fresh client static optimistic (immediate mode) Recordsets of SELECT ID, S FROM T ORDER BY ID (read/write copy): S of row 1 is set to "p-<operation>" with no Update, then the operation runs (Find "ID = 3", Filter "ID = 3", Sort "ID DESC", Clone, Requery, Resync(adAffectAll, adResyncAllValues), MoveNext, MoveFirst, AddNew, Delete, Close); after it read EditMode, Status, the current ID and S, the Errors (cleared); then the first three stored rows through Execute. Asks which operations post, cancel, refuse or keep the pending edit and what reaches the file.
